title: Limits to Political Capture: Evidence from Patent Grants, Disclosures, and Litigation

requirements.description: Raw COMP.FUNDA is a compatible source component: its one-row SAS metadata capture confirms gvkey, fyear, datadate, at, prcc_f, prcc_c, csho and ceq. The active Stata consumer instead merges the separately prepared firm factor.dta by gvkey/year, computes size from at, falls back from prcc_f to prcc_c, and computes market-to-book from csho, prcc_f and ceq. The raw fields are supported; fyear-to-year mapping, selection/preparation of firm factor.dta, observation coverage and the full study-year range remain unresolved.

routes.description: The complete required product is author-prepared firm factor.dta. Its active consumer merges by gvkey/year, computes size from at, uses prcc_c as a fallback for prcc_f, and computes market-to-book from csho, prcc_f and ceq. The successful one-row SAS metadata probe confirms that raw COMP.FUNDA supplies gvkey, fyear, datadate, at, prcc_f, prcc_c, csho and ceq, so those raw fields are a compatible component. It does not establish fyear-to-year mapping, author selection/preparation, the prepared file or full firm-panel coverage; the complete required route remains unverified.
routes.expected_period: All firm-panel GVKEY-years; prepared-file selection and full coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Raw CRSP CCMXPF_LNKHIST metadata confirms the GVKEY/PERMNO link keys, link dates and link attributes listed in its route. The consumer joins applicant-company observations by LPERMNO and checks filing dates against link validity dates. A separate prepared gvkey permno link.dta product also needs the company/ticker fields used for disambiguation; that preparation, field coverage and full history are not established by the one-row raw capture.

routes.description: The complete required product is the prepared gvkey permno link.dta mapping. The active consumer joins on LPERMNO, checks filing dates against LINKDT/LINKENDDT, and uses TIC/CONM during company/ticker disambiguation. The successful one-row SAS metadata probe of raw CRSP.CCMXPF_LNKHIST confirms GVKEY, LPERMNO, LINKDT, LINKENDDT, LINKTYPE, LINKPRIM, LIID and LPERMCO, so the raw key/date/link-attribute component is supported; its first sampled row has missing LPERMNO. The capture does not establish the prepared mapping, company/ticker enrichment or complete link history, so the full required route remains unverified.
routes.expected_period: All filing-year links; company/ticker preparation and full historical coverage are unverified.

evidence.quote:
********************************************Create citations file********************************************
import delimited "g_us_patent_citation.tsv", bindquote(strict) clear //downloaded 3/2/2024 from USPTO
drop record_name wipo_kind citation_category citation_sequence
gen year=substr(citation_date,1,4)
drop if year==""
egen count=count(_n),by(citation_patent_id)
keep citation_patent_id count year
duplicates drop
destring year,replace
drop if year<1889|year>2023
ren citation_patent_id patent_number
ren count citation
*Use 2023 as benchmark so a patent granted in 2022 will have one year of data, etc.
gen citationperyear=citation/(2023-year)
drop citation
rename citationperyear citation
sort patent
*Some patents have more than one patent year. Most of them are from the early 1900s. Treat these as errors and drop. 
gen check=(pa==pa[_n-1]|pa==pa[_n+1])
drop if check==1
drop check year
duplicates drop
save "patent citation.dta",replace
evidence.description: Granted-patent citation input is reduced to a citation measure through 2023.

evidence.quote:
****************Merge application and patent information with inventor/applicant information using files created above****************
use "Raw_Application.dta",clear

sort app filing_date pgpub
drop if app==app[_n-1]

merge 1:1 application_id using "patent_crosswalk.dta"

//62% of observations from master data have a merge with the crosswalk -- the rest are not granted patents
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
gen granted=patent_id!=""
//This creates a granted indicator, equal to one if the application is associated with a granted patent

replace pgpub_id_last= pgpub_id_first if missing(pgpub_id_last)
rename pgpub_id_first pgpub_id
recast str11 pgpub_id

merge 1:m pgpub_id using "applicant_locations.dta"
keep if _merge==3
drop _merge
duplicates drop

foreach var of varlist raw_applicant_name_first raw_applicant_name_last raw_applicant_organization raw_city{
	replace `var'=upper(`var')
}
drop if raw_city==""|raw_state==""

gsort application_id raw_applicant_name_first raw_applicant_name_last -applicant_sequence
drop if application_id==application_id[_n-1]& raw_applicant_name_first== raw_applicant_name_first[_n-1]& raw_applicant_name_last== raw_applicant_name_last[_n-1]& applicant_sequence==.

//note that inventor_sequence has some duplicates (typically because both a corporation and an individual are listed as the first inventor)
egen name_id=group(raw_applicant_name_first raw_applicant_name_last raw_city raw_state)

append using "pg_claims_`x'_with_fog_scores.dta"
}

}

evidence.quote:
****Office Action detail downloaded from USPTO (https://www.uspto.gov/ip-policy/economic-research/research-datasets/office-action-research-dataset-patents) on 9/13/2023****

use "office_actions.dta",clear

keep app_id mail_dt header_missing fp_missing
duplicates drop
ren app_id application_number
destring application_number,replace
egen max_header_missing=max(header_missing),by(application_number)
egen max_fp_missing=max(fp_missing),by(application_number)

replace FP=1-FP_Missing
drop mail

evidence.quote:
//merge in gvkeys so we can link to Garcia Norli 
joinby lpermno using "gvkey permno link.dta"
quietly unique gvkey, by(pgpub_id name_id lpermno) gen(count)
gsort pgpub_id name_id lpermno -count
replace count=count[_n-1] if count==.&name_id==name_id[_n-1]&year==year[_n-1]
tabulate count
sort count pgpub_id name_id lpermno
gen within=0
replace within=1 if (filing_date>linkdt&filing_date<linkenddt)
drop if count>0 & within!=1
drop count 
quietly unique gvkey, by(pgpub_id name_id lpermno) gen(count)
gsort pgpub_id name_id lpermno -count
replace count=count[_n-1] if count==.&name_id==name_id[_n-1]&year==year[_n-1]
tabulate count
drop count lpermco linktype linkprim linkenddt linkdt liid tic conm

evidence.quote:

winsor2 mb,c(1 99) replace

dependency_review.description: applicants.dta is produced from the raw PatentsView applicant table and then appended with inventor records.
names_not_disambig.dta is produced by combining the applicant/inventor name records and feeds the later name-location/firm matching stages.

The consumer joins through the prepared gvkey permno link.dta by LPERMNO, checks filing dates against LINKDT/LINKENDDT, and uses company/ticker fields for disambiguation. The successful one-row CCMXPF_LNKHIST capture confirms raw link keys/dates and attributes only; preparation, company/ticker enrichment and full historical coverage remain unresolved.
application_data.dta is a required Public PAIR/PatEx source for examiner and application-class fields; it produces examiners_class.dta.
Raw_Application.dta is generated from pg_published_application.tsv after application/date filtering and is consumed by applicant/patent-link stages.
KPSS_2022.dta is a required patent-valuation input; the master merge uses the patent key and xi_nominal to derive market value.
application_applicant_info_temp.dta is generated by joining Raw_Application, the patent crosswalk and applicant_locations.dta.
zip district github.dta is an external ZIP/state/district input used by the committee-city and turnover stages.
The application-claim FOG family is a direct annual input to the readability summary/merge stage; its producer and scoring contract remain unresolved.
The granted-patent claim FOG family is a direct annual input to the readability summary/merge stage; its producer and scoring contract remain unresolved.
The application-description FOG family is a direct annual input to the readability summary/merge stage; its producer and scoring contract remain unresolved.
pg_claims_2004_scope.dta is the first annual application-scope input; the code appends later years and computes independent-claim summaries.
g_claims_2004_scope.dta is the first annual granted-patent scope input; the code appends later years and computes patent-scope summaries.
The dynamic pg_claims_`x'_scope.dta edge covers the 2005–2020 annual application-scope files read inside the loop.
claim_2004.dta is generated within the 2004–2020 loop from pg_claims_*_scope.dta and is appended to produce application_claim.dta.
patents.dta is the external 2020 USPTO litigation patent file; it is filtered into patents_litigation.dta and merged to derive litigation.
transactions.dta is an external PatEx input used for first action dates, meetings and compressed transaction counts, then merged into the master.
office_actions.dta is an external 2017 USPTO file used to construct missing-form indicators.
CMZ master.dta is produced by the do-file after joins/derived variables and is consumed by descriptive and regression output sections.
House data.xls is the House committee/seniority input used to create city-level committee seniority.
Senate data.xls is the Senate committee/seniority input used to create the Senate seniority and turnover outputs.
House data.xlsx is a separate workbook input to the turnover construction.
state_10Kall.csv is actively imported as a Python output and reshaped into state/Cik/year counts before the GVKEY link merge.

The documented institutional WRDS subscriptions are not evidence of a current access barrier. Local one-row catalog probes are candidates only and do not establish population, year coverage or a compatible author export.
No author program, model, import, compile, parser, statistical or descriptive trial was run; no package/source files were changed, no dataset was downloaded and execution_verified remains false.
